programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes a hard look into the life of identical twin sisters, Talia and Alissa, who say they are homeless and addicted to heroin, and that nothing seems to stop them from scoring drugs – no matter who it hurts. Watch as they share their daily lives with the Dr. Phil cameras and hear them discuss being 21-year-old “prostitutes” together, explain that they have stolen change from a blind man and once stole from over 50 residents at a nursing home, all to get money for heroin. Dr. Phil’s offer of help includes something so radical, it’s a Dr. Phil show first, surprising the twins, their family and the studio audience. But will Talia and Alissa accept the help offered to try to save their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues the story of a mother who says she lives in fear every day that her 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, could be killed by a man she met on the Internet.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some moms don't want to grow up, and others don't want to grow old. Dr. Phil talks to women walking on the wild side and tries to rein them back in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s being called the ultimate form of child abuse -- brainwashing your children against an ex-spouse to win custody. Could you be harming your child emotionally and not even know it? First up, Ken is a successful surgeon who says he’s the victim of parental alienation syndrome (PAS). He says he hasn’t seen his 14-year-old son since last October and claims his ex-wife destroyed what was once a loving father-son relationship. Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, says Ken’s situation is a classic case of kids being turned against their father, but family law attorney Liz Kates says PAS is a phony tactic used by some men to get out of paying child support. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, Karen lost custody of her children after she was accused of parental alienation syndrome by her ex-husband. Karen maintains her innocence, so why were her parental rights terminated when her daughters accused her ex of sexual abuse? Plus, 19-year-old Demi joins the show via Web cam and says her father verbally abused her mother during their divorce. Now, she fears that her 15-year-old sister is caught in the middle. Find out what you can do if you’re caught between sparring parents. And, meet a father so desperate to see his young children, he kidnapped them from his ex-wife and went on the lam for two years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is your household in turmoil? Do you feel overwhelmed by your child’s temper tantrums? Dr. Phil reveals the best solutions for common parenting dilemmas, and he has help from educational consultant Dr. Michele Borba. Lizette and Ricky have four children under age 6, and they say their 3-year-old daughter’s behavior is completely out of control. They say she hits, scratches, yells and screams, and her meltdowns are rubbing off on her siblings. Find out what happens when Dr. Borba makes a house call. Then, learn why Lizette says she left home for a month! Plus, Stefani and Shenan are engaged and struggling to blend their families. She has four kids and he has three, but when all seven of them are together, they say it’s utter madness! Dr. Phil and Dr. Borba have advice for keeping the peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on with Dr. Phil guests when the show is over? Get a sneak peek backstage after explosive episodes and find out what happens when the guests return home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it wrong to go dating for dollars? Dr. Phil’s guests say if you want to court them, you have to pay to play! Baje says she uses sex appeal to get cash, jewelry and expensive trips from men. She says she never leaves home without her "gold-digging kit," and you won’t believe what it contains! Her friend, Michelle, says Baje taught her all the secrets to getting money from men, and she doesn't see anything wrong with accepting gifts from wealthy suitors. With the help of an NFL superstar, Dr. Phil teaches these materialistic ladies a lesson they won't forget. Then, attorney Lauren Lake says gold digging is "two sandwiches short of a prostitution picnic," but Lucia, a radio talk show host, says that using men for money is no worse than men using women for sex. Don’t miss their heated debate! And, Emilie says she's not a gold digger; she’s just looking for a rich man to support her extravagant lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sex is supposed to be a healthy, normal, natural intimacy that couples share. So why does it threaten to destroy these guests' relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever fib? Did you know that people lie three times in 10 minutes when they're trying to get to know each other? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of why people tell tales and how to put an end to the falsehoods. Erin admits that a lie she told her ex-husband, Eric, destroyed their marriage and led to divorce. Is Erin now ready to be honest, or is she still hiding the truth? And, does this couple have a chance of making it work the second time? Next, Dr. Robert Feldman sheds light on why men and women are dishonest. Then, Michelle was engaged to a man whom she thought was her soul mate, until she hired a private investigator and found out he was lying to her. Should she ever trust him again? Dr. Phil offers advice for how to change your relationship with a liar. And, Dr. Phil shares Tweets he received of lies people have told. Is yours one of them?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's the affair that has everyone talking! Ed, a successful doctor, revealed to his wife, Kandi, that he was having an affair and his mistress is pregnant. Now, with the baby due in less than eight weeks, Dr. Phil checks back in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike thought his wife, Bridgette's, excessive shopping was destroying their marriage. What started as a shopping intervention turned into an intervention with a family in crisis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's do or die for the men today, as their partners tell them to either walk down the aisle or walk the highway! Plus, Robin has tips for maintaining a healthy relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis- the former mistress of a doctor convicted of murdering his wife- speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you enter into a new relationship, putting your best foot forward and making a solid commitment is important. But how do you do that if you've been burned in the past or are still in love with an ex?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look at a teacher sex scandal that has a school and families divided in a small town in Texas. High school teacher Joelle Ogletree faces accusations of sexual misconduct with some of her male students. Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you living way beyond your means? Do you shop for one pair of shoes, but come home with 10? Do you look great on the outside, while secretly facing financial ruin? Dr. Phil has advice for putting down the checkbook.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What do you do when life’s problems seem so overwhelming that it feels like there’s no way out? Kenny, who was one of the first responders to the 9/11 tragedy, says he still struggles with post-traumatic stress disorder and other health challenges. His wife, Cyndi, and daughter, Gina, say he just sits on the couch and obsesses about that fateful day, and they feel he needs to get over it. Can Kenny get his life and his health back? Then, Steve and Jacki have been married for four years, and Steve says he’s at a crossroads in his relationship. He says his wife puts him last and moved her elderly parents into their home while he was on the road. Jacki says she can’t get over her husband’s insensitivity to her dying mother, and isn’t sure if their relationship can be saved. Is it time for Steve to say enough is enough and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished finally faces her family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a mystery that has America absolutely baffled. An Idaho teenager and her younger brother with special needs vanish and have not been seen by anyone in almost four months. Their mother, Lori Vallow, appears completely unbothered by the fact that her two children are just gone, and is in Hawaii seemingly carefree with her fifth and newest husband, Chad Daybell, who reportedly has extreme religious beliefs. Adding to the mystery, four untimely deaths surround Lori and Chad, yet she still refuses to say a single word about her children’s whereabouts. How could these children just go missing for months without a trace? Where are they? Today, family members of Lori Vallow speak to Dr. Phil to try and shine a light on this unbelievable situation. Don’t miss it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pat and his wife, Sarah, claim they’re scared for their family’s safety. Pat claims his father, John, is delusional, violent, paranoid and so dangerous, that Pat sleeps on the couch in his living room to protect his wife and two children in the event that John comes to the house at night to harm them. Pat and Sarah say John’s delusions have gotten so bad they’ve had to cut ties with him. John, on the other hand, completely denies the allegations. He says his daughter-in-law is to blame for stealing his son, filling his head with evil and turning Pat against him. Can Dr. Phil bridge the gap between father and son and bring this whole family back together again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with some opinionated guests! Can he get them to see that their opinions and judgments can be hurtful?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they are tired of being bullied, bossed around and treated like personal assistants by their domineering spouses. They say they're ready to take a stand!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Whether it's personal guilt or family pressure, many couples feel a tremendous need to rush to the altar. Heather and Jeff were virgins when they started dating. After their relationship started heating up, Heather feared judgment from her minister father and ran down the aisle with Jeff. Now their home is full of resentment. Why is she disappointed with Jeff and is there hope for their future? Next, Michelle said she had doubts about marrying Steve as she was walking down the aisle. Find out what is causing the overwhelming conflict in their marriage nine years later? Plus, two best friends are plotting to make sure their kids get married! But what do the teens think?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores potential new clues in the separate cold cases of Ashley Summers and Michelle Parker, who have been missing for several years. What happened to these women? Plus, “Homeless Joe” returns to Dr. Phil -- how is he now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Despite having 3,000 bottles of shampoo, 30,000 shirts, 5,000 cookbooks, and boxes on top of boxes of things, Kristen says she doesn’t think she is a hoarder. But Kristen claims her “collection of things” has created a problem. She just bought a new house and after already moving in 600 boxes, she says she's completely running out of room, and there is a whole lot more to pack. From buying unclaimed storage containers to dumpster diving, Kristen says she cannot give up an opportunity to collect something that’s a good deal. But is there more to Kristen’s collecting than meets the eye? Find out the shocking reason Kristen says it is hard for her to part with her belongings. Plus, meet Kristen’s friends who say they are concerned that her “hoarding” is keeping their friend isolated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Dr. Phil first met this family, their house was filled with yelling, screaming and name-calling. Dr. Phil checks in to see if Jackie has calmed her raging temper, if Zoli and Derek are speaking to each other and if the kids are following the new house rules.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michael is a “starving artist” who thinks getting a 9 to 5 job would interfere with his creativity. He’s broke, jobless and was recently homeless and living in the woods. His mother, Pat, wants him to get a real job, stop being a mooch, and start being more like his professional brothers! Then, meet two brothers: one has an MBA and a successful career, while the other has been addicted to drugs and running from the police. His parents are worried he may end up in prison for the rest of his life. Can Dr. Phil help him change before it’s too late?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Amanda has been missing for five months. Her parents believe she ran away with her boyfriend and what they call his "gypsy family." Dr. Phil puts his own investigator on the case to go in search of the runaway teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis- the former mistress of a doctor convicted of murdering his wife- speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: “He loves me. He loves me not.” Wouldn’t it be great if there was a formula to get your partner to commit? Josie has been dating Curry for more than three years, and she says she’s ready to dump him if he doesn’t pop the question soon. Curry says he loves his girlfriend, so why is he afraid to walk down the aisle? Will Josie hold out for a ring, or will she kick this commitment-phobe to the curb? Then, Melissa thought she had it all –- the ring, the dress and the man of her dreams –- until she discovered her wedding was a sham. She says her husband, John, lied about how many times he’d been married, but the biggest tale of all is that he’s still married to another woman! John admits that he lied about being divorced, but says Melissa wouldn’t have stayed with him if he told her the truth. Will Melissa ever be able to trust him again ... and should she? Plus, meet a couple who says their dream wedding turned into a nightmare when the wedding planner scammed them out of $30,000.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sex is supposed to be a healthy, normal, natural intimacy that couples share. So why does it threaten to destroy these guests' relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Screaming, making excuses, irrational outbursts ... No one knows how a drug addict behaves better than Brandon. With five years of sobriety under his belt, he and his mother, Debbie, are paying it forward. Now, Brandon meets his match! After seeing Dr. Phil’s intervention with Karli, Kim wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old daughter, Jaime, who's addicted to OxyContin. Five months ago, Kim’s family performed an intervention with Jaime. After agreeing to go to a detox facility, Jaime checked herself out and tried to commit suicide. Now, Kim says the young woman has started injecting cocaine and takes any opiate she can get her hands on. Don’t miss the most dramatic intervention yet. Will Jaime finally agree to get treatment, or will she fight everyone tooth and nail? Plus, addicted to heroin and OxyContin, Karli had overdosed and relapsed many times before her mother brought her to Dr. Phil and Brandon for help. How is she now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany, 23, shocked her parents when she admitted that she was hooked on heroin. After successfully completing a treatment program, and 166 days into her recovery, she relapsed. Find out who she blames for her addiction problems!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Although New Year’s day has already come and gone, Dr. Phil’s going to give you the keys to sticking with this year’s resolutions. You’ll meet three women all battling to keep their New Year’s promise to themselves, and through them you’ll learn how to recognize what’s keeping you from becoming the person you’ve always wanted to be. Whether it’s to quit smoking, lose weight or get your finances in shape, it’s time to stop making excuses and start getting results.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pamela says in just nine days, she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations with their children. Pamela says she believes Justin is a dangerous narcissist who she claims has locked the kids out of the house and attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Pamela says she will do whatever it takes to protect her kids from Justin, even if that means going to jail. Justin claims Pamela is a hateful, controlling, bitter ex, who has brainwashed their children into making up stories, and says Pamela’s claims of abuse are lies! These parents have been back and forth to court and claim nothing has been resolved. So, who is telling the truth? Is Justin an abusive father, or is Pamela a jealous ex making up stories for revenge? Can Dr. Phil get these parents on the same page for the sake of their children? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues an intense discussion on negotiated infidelity. Chrissy, a mother of three, says her husband, Scott, refuses to dump his girlfriend and wants her to consider an open relationship. During their first appearance, things got heated when Tracy, Scott’s mistress of five years, came onstage to share her side of the story. Will Scott choose between his lover and his wife, or will both women kick him to the curb? Then, not everyone believes cheating is a bad thing. Holly Hill, author of Sugarbabe, says negotiated infidelity empowers women. She and her boyfriend, Dino, have been in an open relationship for three years, and they say this arrangement helps couples avoid strife and mistrust. What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, see a follow up with Charles, one of Dr. Phil’s most controversial guests, who wanted to explore a polyfidelity lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: All newlyweds experience the typical ups and downs during their first year of marriage, but are these relationships already too far gone to be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles two news stories that have captivated millions. First up, is it ever appropriate to confront your child’s bullies? That’s what James Jones says he did when he boarded his 12-year-old daughter, Chatari’s, school bus, and the video of his tirade went viral! James says some of the students terrorized his child, who suffers from cerebral palsy, and his actions resulted in two second-degree misdemeanor charges against him. CNN contributor Roland Martin joins the show, and he says James should be named Father of the Year for protecting Chatari, who was reportedly hit, called names and had condoms thrown at her. Roland goes head-to-head with attorney Areva Martin, who says James’s behavior was unwarranted. Did this dad cross the line? What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, the disappearance of David Hartley reads like a murder mystery. His wife, Tiffany, says they were on vacation when David was shot in the head by Mexican pirates while jet skiing. His body was never recovered, and Mexican authorities question if the event really occurred. Some people wonder if Tiffany was involved, but she maintains her innocence. Find out why she declined a lie detector test, and hear Dr. Phil’s strong message for her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: “Normal” is a relative term. Tradition, ethnicity and religion can determine what’s conventional, but people in America often disagree on what’s considered “the norm.” Today, a woman who takes care of fifteen cats and a man who works 100 hours per week joins Dr. Phil. Common they’re not, and their peculiar ways are adversely affecting the lives of those around them. Dr. Phil cuts to the chase with one simple question, “How’s that working for you?” and these guests walk away with a new perspective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles one of the most dangerous trends affecting young adults today -- cyberbullying. Kalista, 20, claims she has been virtually assaulted for almost two years by Taylor, 20, a girl who Kalista says loves to attack people when they’re at their lowest point. Kalista says Taylor has posted photos of her online and written lies that she does drugs, is a stripper and a prostitute. Kalista says she’s not the only victim of Taylor’s alleged bullying -- Shelby, 22, and Shayna, 21, say they also have been targeted -- and she’s worried someone may be pushed too far. How do they say Taylor’s alleged actions have affected them? Taylor admits she has made nasty comments -- why does she say she was only defending herself? Dr. Phil brings all parties together to try to end the hostility. Are these young women ready to unplug and end the animosity? Plus, hear from the mother of a 12-year-old girl who tragically ended her own life after being cyberbullied. Will her story make an impact?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Domestic battles are never fun. But what happens when battling becomes a lifestyle? Today's guests want to learn how to put an end to their family feud once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever felt like you had to walk on eggshells around someone, constantly worrying about how they would react to anything you said or did? What if you were married to that person?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Send the kids out of the room because Dr. Phil is talking about sex! Was the passion off the charts when you first started dating your spouse, but now your bedroom is a dead zone? If so, it’s time to resuscitate your relationship! With the help of Rabbi Shmuley Boteach, host of TLC’s Shalom in the Home and author of the book, The Kosher Sutra: Eight Sacred Secrets for Reigniting Desire and Restoring Passion for Life, Dr. Phil speaks with couples who say they’ve lost their libidos and want to bring back the magic. First up are Joy and Mark who say they haven’t had sex in almost four years. In fact, Joy says the last great sex she had was in 1988! Find out why Mark is terrified to make love to his wife. And, Kim and Adam have been married only four months and say they fight more than they have sex. How can they enjoy the honeymoon phase if they go to bed mad at each other? Plus, don’t miss the top five reasons you should have sex!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Robin joins Dr. Phil to answer your questions ... including the ones asking her to give up the dirt on Dr. Phil! What's Dr. Phil really like at home? What lands him in the doghouse? How does Robin stay in shape?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s a case that has grabbed national headlines and rattled a tight-knit Ohio community: Two high school football players are accused of raping a 16-year-old girl while partying last August, and many community members are calling the investigation a cover-up. Are city leaders trying to protect the town’s beloved football program, or is justice being served?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The 1957 kidnapping and murder of Maria Ridulph went cold for 55 years, until Jack McCullough, once known as John Tessier, was arrested and eventually convicted -- despite maintaining his innocence. Dr. Phil speaks to family members on both sides. Could McCullough have been wrongfully convicted?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with a family torn apart. Carole and Bill have been married 19 years and have six daughters. Carole is questioning whether she wants to stay married, and two of their daughters, Kristin and Jenny, accuse her of lying to them about another man in her life. They say their mother has turned into someone they don't recognize, and they're worried about how the family turmoil is affecting their younger sisters. The 18-year-old went into labor without even knowing she was pregnant. Are the two younger girls at risk as well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Being a single mother is hard enough, but imagine juggling soccer practice, PTA meetings and homework ... all while trying to cover up a secret life. Susan is a single mom with two kids who works as a prostitute to pay the bills. She says she's never had a real job and is addicted to the money she makes as an escort. Can Susan ditch her dangerous job and turn her life around? Then, Stephanie is a single mother of four and has been hiding a secret for 12 years. She's addicted to painkillers and takes up to 60 times the recommended dosage just to make it through the day. Fearing for their lives and those of their children, the women turn to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is addressing what he feels is a red alert crisis in America: drug and alcohol addiction, which affects 28 million addicts. Over the past 16 seasons, Dr. Phil has been able to help nearly 500 guests with inpatient treatment for substance abuse. Today, he will update some of their amazing recovery stories in hopes that they might inspire others who are struggling with addiction. Find out what happened to three sisters, Valeen, Amanda, and Tiffany, who were not only dangerously addicted to heroin, but also using it together every day. And what happen to Niki, who appeared on the show addicted, homeless, and pregnant? Niki returns to give her shocking update. Bethany said not even a medically induced coma and open heart surgery could get her to stop her dangerous heroin addiction -- find out how she’s doing now. Plus, numerous past guests and their families return to the Dr. Phil stage to share their amazing stories of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You never think that a loved one could hurt, or even destroy, your family. That's exactly what happened to Donna and her two daughters, whose story begins in a small Oklahoma town in the heartland of America. Donna dated Jerry for five years. He wouldn’t let her break off their relationship and when she finally did, no one could have predicted the lengths to which Jerry would go to hurt her. This real-life drama unfolded with horror, violence and unimaginable twists. See what good Dr. Phil believes can come from this unthinkable tragedy. Is there hope for this family’s recovery?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: James and Dawn say their family has been in crisis since their recent separation, and that their three children are stuck in the middle. Why do the kids say they feel pressured to choose sides? And, can this fractured family be fixed?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Steve is a raging alcoholic, and his wife, Sheila, violently abuses him when he drinks. Their two young daughters witness the fighting and are trapped in a war zone. Is it too late for this family to be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it possible to be in love with two men at the same time? Orlena is desperate for help. She says she still has feelings for her ex-husband, Chad, and she adores her current husband, Brent. Chad is a soldier and when duty called, he fought in Iraq. He returned home a changed man and their love shattered forever. What changed Chad, and what caused Orlena to leave him? Devastated and heartbroken, Orlena moved on and into the arms of Brent. Two months after marrying Brent, Chad called and begged Orlena to come back. Find out Brent's strong message for Chad. Since Chad made initial contact with Orlena, they have talked numerous times, and he even spent three days visiting her. What has she been saying to Chad, and are the chats appropriate for a married woman to have? And, will Orlena honor her commitment to Brent or return to the man who broke her heart? Don't miss this heart-wrenching story of a woman torn between two wonderful men.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: 80% of all communication is non-verbal, and, as the old saying goes, you never get a second chance to make a first impression. In this episode, Dr. Phil focuses on body language and appearance rather than the words we speak. Learn from one couple how the little things we do can mean more than saying “I love you.” Plus, is she simply a self-confident woman, or are her actions driving men away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on with Dr. Phil guests when the show is over? Get a sneak peek backstage after explosive episodes and find out what happens when the guests return home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever feel that dealing with your spouse is like having another child? Dr. Phil talks to today’s guests about growing up. We’ll meet a mother of four who feels like her husband is a fifth child and not a good role model. Another guest is afraid to start a family with her husband because of his addiction to video games. Plus, will Dr. Phil convince a wife and mother to let go of her obsession with her high school glory days and live in the present?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obsessed! First, meet a group of women who can’t get enough of a new craze called reborning -- crafting infant dolls that are so life-like, people mistake them for real babies. Some spend thousands of dollars on their dolls, as if they were real children. Author and comedienne Stefanie Wilder-Taylor spends some time with the doting doll lovers during a party you have to see to believe. Then, Anona says she’s obsessed with her hair, which she hasn’t cut in 17 years. Anona says she’s ready for a change, but how will she react when actress Vivica A. Fox and celebrity stylist Phillip Bloch get their hands on her? Don’t miss this amazing makeover! Plus, a mom is concerned over her 7-year-old’s obsession with all things Elvis. And, Vivica A. Fox spills the beans about an obsession she shares with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin … that even Dr. Phil wasn’t aware of!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a mystery that has America absolutely baffled. An Idaho teenager and her younger brother with special needs vanish and have not been seen by anyone in almost four months. Their mother, Lori Vallow, appears completely unbothered by the fact that her two children are just gone, and is in Hawaii seemingly carefree with her fifth and newest husband, Chad Daybell, who reportedly has extreme religious beliefs. Adding to the mystery, four untimely deaths surround Lori and Chad, yet she still refuses to say a single word about her children’s whereabouts. How could these children just go missing for months without a trace? Where are they? Today, family members of Lori Vallow speak to Dr. Phil to try and shine a light on this unbelievable situation. Don’t miss it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trying to blend two families can be like mixing oil and water. Dr. Phil sits down with couples struggling to merge their families and create happy, peaceful homes. Samantha and Rob are on the verge of divorce. She says Rob favors their 4-year-old son over her children from a previous marriage and is too hard on her kids when it comes to discipline. Rob feels his wife undermines him in their home. Can these two align and create a parenting plan that they both agree on? Then, with six kids between them, they may look like the Brady Bunch, but Pete and Maureen say their life is no sitcom. Pete says he and his wife can’t agree on how to raise each other’s kids, and every argument brings them closer to a divorce. And, meet a stepmom who says she can’t bond with her stepkids. Dr. Phil spells out the myths and facts of being a stepparent and the most successful way to fulfill that role. Plus, what is your parenting style?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Juegos de la Vida
programme.desc: Una pareja de pocos recursos económicos en un barrio habanero acuerda hacerse un regalo en su aniversario.

programme.title: Recuerdos De Navidad
programme.desc: Después de años de vivir bajo la excesiva obsesión navideña de su madre, Noelle abandonó la Navidad y comenzó un nuevo capítulo en su vida al mudarse a la ciudad para concentrarse en su carrera. Convirtiéndose en una adicta al trabajo, su jefe la obliga a tomar un descanso para irse a casa y disfrutar de la temporada navideña.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Comedia romántica acerca de dos amigos de la infancia que se reúnen despues de muchos años. Uno de ellos le pide al otro que finja ser judío para conquistar a una chica judía.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas entre Navidad y Año Nuevo, tres hermanas viajan a la encantadora ciudad de Sopot para replantearse su vida amorosa. Todo cambia cuando sus exnovios aparecen buscando una segunda oportunidad.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo que hoy su hijo Jonah quiere ir a una fiesta universitaria, su mujer va a traer a casa a su anciano padre para vivir con ellos, y su jefe parece haberse vuelto más loco y exigente de lo normal. Si puede soportar un día como el de hoy, Ned podrá aguantar cualquier cosa que le depare su vida.

programme.title: Las Seductoras
programme.desc: Max y su hija Page son dos timadoras profesionales que utilizan sus dotes de seducción para estafar a millonarios. Pero, en una ocasión, mientras Max intenta embaucar a un excéntrico magnate del tabaco, Page conoce a un simpático chico y se enamora de él.

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix), un soltero que ha regresado al piso de sus padres en Brooklyn, empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), tan bella como voluble, de la que se enamora locamente, lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar la tranquila vida que se le planteaba… Festival de Cannes 2008, Nominada a la Palma de Oro. Premios César 2009, Nominada la Mejor Película Extranjera. Premio Sant Jordi 2011 al Mejor Actor Extranjero (Joaquin Phoenix).

programme.title: Juegos de la Vida
programme.desc: Una pareja de pocos recursos económicos en un barrio habanero acuerda hacerse un regalo en su aniversario.

programme.title: Recuerdos De Navidad
programme.desc: Después de años de vivir bajo la excesiva obsesión navideña de su madre, Noelle abandonó la Navidad y comenzó un nuevo capítulo en su vida al mudarse a la ciudad para concentrarse en su carrera. Convirtiéndose en una adicta al trabajo, su jefe la obliga a tomar un descanso para irse a casa y disfrutar de la temporada navideña.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Comedia romántica acerca de dos amigos de la infancia que se reúnen despues de muchos años. Uno de ellos le pide al otro que finja ser judío para conquistar a una chica judía.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas entre Navidad y Año Nuevo, tres hermanas viajan a la encantadora ciudad de Sopot para replantearse su vida amorosa. Todo cambia cuando sus exnovios aparecen buscando una segunda oportunidad.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo que hoy su hijo Jonah quiere ir a una fiesta universitaria, su mujer va a traer a casa a su anciano padre para vivir con ellos, y su jefe parece haberse vuelto más loco y exigente de lo normal. Si puede soportar un día como el de hoy, Ned podrá aguantar cualquier cosa que le depare su vida.

programme.title: Las Seductoras
programme.desc: Max y su hija Page son dos timadoras profesionales que utilizan sus dotes de seducción para estafar a millonarios. Pero, en una ocasión, mientras Max intenta embaucar a un excéntrico magnate del tabaco, Page conoce a un simpático chico y se enamora de él.

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix), un soltero que ha regresado al piso de sus padres en Brooklyn, empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), tan bella como voluble, de la que se enamora locamente, lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar la tranquila vida que se le planteaba… Festival de Cannes 2008, Nominada a la Palma de Oro. Premios César 2009, Nominada la Mejor Película Extranjera. Premio Sant Jordi 2011 al Mejor Actor Extranjero (Joaquin Phoenix).

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Willa Davis es propietaria de una tienda de mascotas en San Francisco. Un día se reencuentra con el chico que la dejó plantada en el instituto, y tendrá que luchar con todas sus fuerzas contra su propio corazón para no volver a enamorarse, diez años después.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: Carlos, príncipe de una corona centroeuropea, llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso. María, que trabaja en la clínica veterinaria de su padre, conoce a Carlos por casualidad. Los dos ocultan su verdadera identidad y establecen una relación muy especial. Pronto se descubren sus mentiras mutuas. Carlos descubre que María tiene una hija y María se entera de la condición principesca de Carlos por unas fotos publicadas en la prensa sensacionalista.

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Jorge es músico, lo despiden tratando de encontrar una melodía entre el ruido de la calle, el mismo día que mueren su esposa y su hijo menor. Debe parecer cuerdo para cuidar de su hijo mayor Lucas, de lo contrario también lo perderá.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Hace diez años, una muchacha presenció con impotencia el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque y convirtiéndose en algo que los cazadores nunca hallaráan: un lobo. Ahora, a pesar de que vive al otro lado del mundo, Vivian Gandillon sigue huyendo.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un reconocido chef de Londres disfruta del éxito profesional hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo y abrir un pequeño restaurante en el campo. Así conocerá a Kate, una crítica gastronómica, que le ayudará a creer nuevamente en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de Tod Lubitch, un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico y que debe crecer y permanecer toda su vida confinado en un ambiente estéril. Pero se enamora y deberá elegir entre vivir plenamente o confinado.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de “Paris, je t’aime” (2006), doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como plató y narran diferentes historias de amor en esta película coral.

Entonces, cuando Tyler Toys está buscando una nueva agencia para representarlos, Haley está más que lista para armar el terreno de juego. Sin embargo, su jefe teme que su falta de espíritu navideño sea un factor y la envía al Campamento de Navidad.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: El francés Stéphane Peterhansel, ganador del emblemático Rally Dakar en 13 ocasiones, tuvo una carrera bastante inusual, ya que pasó de las motos a los coches y tuvo un enorme éxito con ambos vehículos.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf es el fundador de una pequeña pero conocida empresa de fabricación de coches en Baviera que se especializa en construir su propia visión de los superdeportivos homologados para la calle sobre la base de carrocerías Porsche.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Entre los años 1950 y 1970, Hans Herrmann alcanzó la fama como exitoso piloto de Fórmula 1 y de coches deportivos para fabricantes como Porsche, Mercedes-Benz y Maserati, y ganó también las 24 Horas de Le Mans en varias ocasiones.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: La gente llamaba a Sabine Schmitz la "Reina de la Nordschleife" cuando conducía sus coches de carreras Porsche o BMW en la famosa Nordschleife del Nürburgring.

programme.title: Historia carro

programme.title: Historia carro

programme.title: Historia carro

programme.title: El último DKW: El F12 Roadster

Aquí es donde los participantes de toda Europa compiten en el Air-Strip del museo de la aviación en la carrera de un octavo de milla. Frank compite con su Dragster-Camaro de 700 caballos de fuerza para defender el título.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El empresario alemán Tillmann Miritz comienza su sueño en la ciudad que nunca duerme: un viaje por carretera con su propio coche vintage hacia los iconos automovilísticos de su juventud. Con su Mercedes 280 SE 3.5 descapotable visita al legendario distribuidor de coches clásicos Eliot Cuker de Nueva York, que hizo su fortuna con su pasión por los coches antiguos en el centro de Manhattan.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El recorrido de Tillmann Miritz para encontrar rarezas automovilísticas en los EE.UU. va desde el puente de Manhattan hasta Long Island. Su Mercedes descapotable lo lleva al viñedo Wöllfer Estate, donde se cultivan algunos de los mejores vinos. Su dueño esconde en el garaje una camioneta que representa el "American Way of Life" rural como casi ningún otro coche: el Chevrolet 3100.

programme.title: Motorstories

Por eso visitan a los especialistas de Down Town Garage con más de 50 motores. El lugar es también un restaurante americano con un motel donde puedes pasar la noche con un estilo genuino.

programme.title: Motorstories

Frank y su equipo de Special Cars Berlin también asisten al evento trayendo consigo varios coches. Kati y Patrick viajan a Berlín con su Chevy. Al día siguiente, Fran participa en una carrera en el aeropuerto.

RS, por cierto, significa ciclismo - tiene una potencia de 1 a 2 fuerzas humanas. La relación peso-potencia es de 75 kg por MS.

programme.title: Tuning

Este Audi está realmente sobrecualificado para los ventisqueros salvajes.

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ante las intenciones de Ezequiel, Octavia y Marcelina agreden verbalmente a Camila. Max le propone y Camila duda pero accede a casarse con él. En una cena, Ezequiel reúne a sus hijos y Camila será la homenajeada especial.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: En la cena, el tema principal será Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel dice que esa mujer fue una oportunista que enamoró y se aprovechó de su hermano menor, Leoncio. Astrid ofende agregando que fue una prostituta, culpable de la guerra entre las dos familias por su relación con Augusto Aragón y también con Leoncio López.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insiste en saber sobre su relación familiar, piensa que pueda ser prima de Max. Camila, protege a Chantal, una niña que vende flores.

programme.desc: Joe se va a realizar pruebas médicas en la Clínica Mayo en Phoenix, Arizona.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los mejores pilotos de Buffalo, tanto novatos como veteranos, viajan a California para combates aéreos en aviones de combate reales.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El homenaje de Mikey al Día D, un salto en paracaídas con 20 paracaidistas, encuentra un obstáculo cuando Joe se niega a pilotar su DC-3 hasta la zona de salto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba baja al reino para enfrentarse a Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su batalla con Yugi o sigue siendo un duelista despiadado? Una batalla entre el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba y el Dragón B de Ojos Rojos de Joey tiene las respuestas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La banda del duelista americano número 1, Bandido Keith, secuestra a Joey y lo lleva a una cueva con un campo de juego en forma de cementerio. Joey se enfrenta a los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith, que se hacen más fuertes al volver de la tumba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El último recurso de Joey, su carta de suerte del Mago del Tiempo, fracasa contra los monstruos zombis de Bandit Keith. Su racha de suerte llega a su fin, ¿podrán sus mejores habilidades como duelista y el amor por su hermana impulsarlo a la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Era la noche anterior a la batalla final, ¡y muchas criaturas se agitan! Yugi jura derrocar a Pegaso por el bien de su abuelo. Tristán lidera un grupo de exploración para descubrir los secretos de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai se ha recuperado de su anterior derrota contra Joey convirtiéndose en una mejor duelista. ¿Ha aprendido Yugi de su derrota contra Kaiba, o la derrota emocional sigue pesando en su corazón? La respuesta está en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Orgulloso de su fuerza como duelista en el juego, Joey desafía a Yugi para tener derecho a enfrentarse a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se horroriza cuando Joey utiliza la carta del Mago del Tiempo contra él, ¡la misma carta que él le dio a Joey en señal de amistad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
